title: Seabbatical at WaterColor
meta_description: Find the perfect Watercolor, FL vacation rental at “Seabbatical”, a luxury 7-bed, 8.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Separate Guest Suite, Golf Cart & WaterColor amenities. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Private Pool - Directly on Western Lake - Beach Club proximity - 0.3 Miles | 3 Mins - Located in Watercolor's Park District - 6 Seater Golf Cart - 6 Adult Bikes Included - Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools (maximum number of 18 wristbands allotted). If wristbands are lost/not returned, there will be a $50 per wristband to replace. Nestled amidst the serene beauty of Watercolor, Florida's Phase 1 Park District, this beach cottage offers a luxurious retreat with 7 bedrooms, 8 full bathrooms, and 1 half bathroom, accommodating up to 18 guests. Situated directly overlooking the lake, this grand residence epitomizes the coastal dune lake lifestyle, featuring expansive outdoor living spaces including multiple deep porches, a rarity in size and elegance. Positioned on a prime lot near Western Lake, guests enjoy access to the community dock right at their doorstep, offering unparalleled views and experiences within Watercolor's prestigious planned community. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by breathtaking vistas of Western Lake from the expansive screened covered porch, perfect for al fresco dining, lounging, and grilling. The open-plan layout seamlessly connects the kitchen, dining, and living areas, complemented by French doors that invite abundant natural light and open to the vast screened porch, extending the home's living space and providing direct access to the community walkover on Western Lake. The main level features a private primary suite with stunning lake views, a luxurious custom bathroom, his and her closets, and a serene sitting room accessing the lakefront deck. The chef's kitchen, with its expansive island and top-of-the-line Viking appliances, is a focal point for gatherings and entertaining. Upstairs, the second level offers guest quarters with five bedroom suites, each designed for comfort and elegance, along with a second-story lakefront screened porch and additional laundry facilities. The attached carriage house above the garage provides added privacy with its living room, kitchen area, and bedroom. The third level adds even more space for guests, including a living/media room, a full bathroom, and an additional bedroom. Beyond the property's luxurious amenities, guests can enjoy Watercolor's thoughtful urban planning, including trails, bridges, parks, and exclusive community amenities such as The Beach Club, Town Center boutiques and dining, water activities at The Boat House and Marina Park, and award-winning tennis and pickleball courts. Experience the luxury of true coastal living along Scenic Highway 30A at this exceptional Watercolor retreat. Outside, embark on adventures with ease thanks to complimentary access to a 6-seater golf cart and 6 adult bikes. Please note, in accordance with WaterColor HOA regulations, all guests aged 5 and older must be included in the guest count to receive wristbands for amenities. Experience the epitome of lakeside luxury and unparalleled convenience at this exquisite Watercolor getaway. Sleeping Arrangements: First Floor -King bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub Second floor -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only -Queen Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo -King Bedroom with Crib - Private Bathroom with Shower Only -King Bedroom - Shared Bathroom with Shower Only -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Third floor -Twin over Twin Trundle Bed - Shared Bathroom with Shower Only
